caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic tool composed of three distinct parts joined at a central pivot point. The upper section consists of a long, tapered handle, which is cylindrical and appears rusted, colored in shades of brown and reddish-brown. Attached perpendicularly to one side of the handle near its top end is a small, flat projection with a hole, giving it a hook-like appearance. Extending downward from the pivot are two curved prongs that form an incomplete circular shape, resembling pincers or tongs. The prongs are also of a rusted metallic texture and coloring, matching the rest of the tool. On the right side, a straight, narrow arm extends horizontally from the pivot, ending in a small circular loop. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color with no other objects or details.
title: Snubber for Bull
